points.description: States that storage is a function of inflow and outflow discharge only (S depends on I and O only), and is calculated using the continuity equation.
points.partial_credit: Half (0.5) if only one of the two parts is stated precisely: storage depends on inflow and outflow discharge only, or storage found from the continuity equation.

points.description: States that the parameters K and x (n in the model answer) remain constant, until the channel slope/reach is changed, and that K depends on the travel time of the flood wave through the reach.
points.partial_credit: Half (0.5) if only one of the two parts is stated precisely: K and x/n constant until the channel slope changes, or K depends on the travel of the flood wave through the reach.

rubric.notes: Full marks for a point need every part of it stated precisely with the correct terms (storage as a function of inflow and outflow discharge only, continuity equation, constant K and x/n until slope changes, K linked to travel of the flood wave through the reach). Half a point only when one of its two parts is clearly and precisely stated. Vague statements such as 'it routes floods through a channel', or any wrong statement within a point, earn nothing for that point.
